operators.name: fused_abs_sign_forward
semantics: Computes elementwise abs then sign: y = sign(abs(x)). For float32, sign returns -1.0 for negative inputs, 0.0 for zero, 1.0 for positive inputs.
This matched the reference sequence torch.sign(torch.abs(x)), which is equivalent to the original sign for all finite values.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, strides and memory layout.
Implement as single CUDA kernel; no intermediate torch.abs call.
Elementwise absolute value of input tensor x.
Output shape [1024,3,512,256], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Elementwise sign of the tensor after abs, producing -1.0 for negative, 0.0 for zero, 1.0 for positive values.
Output shape [1024,3,512,256], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
